items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1962-04-11
items.q: Oh yeah, him and John told us they'd been all over.

ctx.x: A lot here or someplace like that? Yeah, around the lot here I think. Yeah, they were. But he traveled around with big bands, don't you say?
Oh yeah, him and John told us they'd been all over.
Well what kind of bands were they? Were they dance bands, regular orchestras, or were they dance bands?
